title: PR Closed workflow: delete a closed PR's merge-ref caches in a dependent job with job-level actions: write
answers: Why are GitHub Actions caches from a closed or merged pull request removed automatically?
How do I add another cleanup step to the workflow that runs when a PR is closed?
Where is the cache deletion for closed PRs handled, and which permissions does it need?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/pr-closed.yml (workflow "PR Closed", triggered by pull_request_target closed) handles closing or merging a PR: the `cancel` job cancels that PR's workflow runs, and the `delete-caches` job runs after it (`needs: cancel`) to delete the PR's Actions caches.
Rule: Keep cache cleanup in a separate dependent job, not in `cancel`. It deletes only caches whose ref is `refs/pull/$PR_NUMBER/merge`, via `gh cache delete --all --ref ... --succeed-on-no-caches --repo ...`. Grant `actions: write` at job level only, and keep top-level workflow permissions denied for caches. Use `runs-on: ubuntu-slim` and `timeout-minutes: 5`.
Constraints: Applies to the pull_request_target closed trigger in this workflow. The cleanup targets only the merge ref; caches under other refs are not touched by this job. Use the same job-level permission pattern when adding other steps that need write access, rather than widening top-level permissions.
applies: GitHub Actions workflow changes that touch PR lifecycle events, cache cleanup, or token permissions in .github/workflows/pr-closed.yml.
says: Build cache storage is running out of space from old closed pull requests.
Automatically clear build caches when a pull request gets closed or merged.
Cache cleanup fails during pull request closure due to insufficient workflow permissions.
Make sure workflow cache removal runs only after running jobs are cancelled.

Caches are purged using gh cache delete --all --ref refs/pull/$PR_NUMBER/merge --succeed-on-no-caches --repo ..., targeting only merge-ref caches without touching other refs.
